{
  "first_3_seconds": "Close-up on Juliana's stunned face as she asks 'How long?' then a two-shot of the Lady in Gold Gown and Gerald looking down at her, with the Lady saying 'Long enough to know he was never going to marry you.'",
  "ending": "Gerald turns his back on Juliana and walks toward Clarissa, saying '...when Clarissa is the true jewel of the county,' as Clarissa smiles radiantly.",
  "problems": [
    "The first line 'How long?' lacks immediate context; a stranger may not know what betrayal is being referenced until the Lady's reply lands at 2.6s.",
    "The father's silent refusal is emotionally strong but slightly drawn out (6.6s-18.4s), risking viewer drop-off before the Matriarch's confrontation.",
    "The final insult about 'plainness and low value' is on-the-nose but effective; however, the cut happens right after Gerald's line, leaving Juliana's reaction unseen."
  ],
  "hook_score": 8,
  "cliffhanger_score": 9,
  "standalone_score": 9,
  "verdict": "post",
  "pitch": "A bride is publicly humiliated and replaced by her own family in the first three seconds—impossible not to watch what she does next."
}
